_comment: Mobile Lighthouse pass — second config because @lhci/cli applies ONE settings object per run (no per-URL override exists; verified against 0.15). No `preset` key: Lighthouse's default emulation IS mobile; `.lighthouserc.json` is the desktop override. Same thresholds as desktop — never loosen one profile to pass. `?shift=night` pins the palette (LHCI runs a fresh profile with no localStorage). Run via `pnpm run audit`, which builds ONCE then runs both configs against the existing dist/ — startServerCommand here deliberately has no build step, so a bare `lhci autorun` serves whatever dist/ you last built.
